description: P5.2 Chat interface (Section 8.1) AND P5.3 Model selector (Section 8.2), built together because they share the per-message override seam: per architecture.md Section 8.2 'Per-message override ownership', the transient override is a single value owned by the active conversation's routing store (state/conversations.ts); the PerMessageOverrideControl (rendered in the Composer) only reads/writes that shared value, and the Composer's send_message call reads it and passes it as overrideRoute?, then the store clears it after send so the override applies to exactly one message. Build both surfaces so this seam is wired once, coherently. Depends on FEAT-001 (IPC wrappers + stores + list_available_models/get_messages/set_conversation_route commands).
steps: CHAT (src/features/chat/): implement MessageList (renders the active conversation's message list from the conversations store), MessageBubble (renders MessageContent variants: text, toolCalls, toolResults, attachments — show tool-call name+arguments and tool-result content/isError distinctly), StreamingIndicator (shown while a message status is 'streaming'), Composer (textarea + send button + stop button that calls stopGeneration; hosts the PerMessageOverrideControl), RouteBadge (renders a message's RouteMetadata: providerId/model + source + rationale on hover/tooltip), PermissionPrompt (modal shown for a pending permissionRequested; buttons call resolvePermission(requestId, { allow, remember })).

CHAT wiring: on mount/active-conversation-change, load messages via the store (getMessages). Consume message_delta (append delta to the streaming assistant message), message_complete (finalize status/route/usage), message_error (mark error + show message), permission_requested (enqueue -> render PermissionPrompt). Send flow: Composer reads the transient override from the conversations store, calls sendMessage(conversationId, content, override), then the store clears the override. Assistant output arrives via events, not the send return value.

MODEL SELECTOR (src/features/model-selector/): implement RoutingModeToggle (Auto vs Manual; Manual reveals the picker; Auto clears the pin via setConversationRoute(id, null)), ProviderModelPicker (consumes providers store from list_available_models; group Local vs Cloud — derive Local from ProviderKind lmStudio, and genericOpenAI with a loopback baseUrl if that info is available, else group by a provided flag; show capability hints from Capabilities and rough cost from TokenPrice inputPerMtok/outputPerMtok), PerMessageOverrideControl (reads/writes the shared transient override in the conversations store — NOT its own copy), AutoRationaleTooltip (shows why Auto picked a model, via getRouteExplanation or the last message's RouteMetadata.rationale).

MODEL SELECTOR wiring: setting a pin calls setConversationRoute(conversationId, route); clearing returns to Automatic (setConversationRoute(id, null)); the one-off override writes manual_override into the shared store consumed by the Composer. Consume providers_changed (refresh available models) and conversation_updated (refresh the conversation's pin/mode). Reuse the ProviderModelPicker as a reusable component (it is also reused by the agent editor's DefaultRoutePicker in FEAT-003) — place it where both features can import it (e.g. export from model-selector and import in agent-editor, or lift into components/).

TESTS (vitest + RTL): for chat — render MessageList/MessageBubble with fixture messages (each MessageContent variant); assert Composer send calls sendMessage with the current override then the store clears it; feed synthetic message_delta/message_complete/message_error via the store's event function and assert the bubble updates + StreamingIndicator toggles; assert PermissionPrompt renders on permission_requested and its buttons call resolvePermission. For model selector — assert RoutingModeToggle switches modes and Auto clears the pin (setConversationRoute null); assert ProviderModelPicker groups Local vs Cloud and shows capability/price; assert PerMessageOverrideControl writes the shared store value and that a subsequent send carries it; assert providers_changed refreshes the model list. Mock invoke and listen per the FEAT-001 pattern.

LOCAL VERIFY: run `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend and fix formatting; self-audit eslint/tsc rules (no unused, no any, exhaustive-deps on effects, single-line unions <100 cols). Report eslint/tsc/vitest deferred to CI.
acceptance_criteria: Chat surface renders a message list with per-message RouteBadge, streams assistant output via message_delta/message_complete, shows a StreamingIndicator during streaming, surfaces message_error, and shows a PermissionPrompt on permission_requested that resolves via resolvePermission.
Composer send reads the shared transient override from state/conversations.ts, passes it as sendMessage's overrideRoute, and the store clears it after send (override applies to exactly one message).

Model selector offers Auto vs Manual modes; Manual pins via setConversationRoute and Auto clears it; ProviderModelPicker groups Local vs Cloud with capability + price hints; AutoRationaleTooltip shows the routing rationale.
The ProviderModelPicker is implemented as a reusable component consumable by the agent editor (FEAT-003).
vitest/RTL tests cover rendering, mocked-invoke command calls, and event-driven state updates for both surfaces.
verification: Run `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend; confirm clean.
Self-audit ESLint/tsc against the configs; report eslint/tsc/vitest deferred to CI (offline node_modules).
findings:
IMPLEMENTED (frontend-only; no Rust touched). CHAT (src/features/chat/): MessageList (loads history via store.openConversation -> get_messages on mount/active-conversation-change; renders MessageBubble per message; shows 'No conversation selected.' when none active), MessageBubble (renders all four MessageContent variants — text; toolCalls showing name + pretty-printed arguments; toolResults showing ok/error + content with data-error; attachments as links + mime — plus RouteBadge for message.route, an error notice on status==='error', and StreamingIndicator while status==='streaming'), StreamingIndicator (role=status), RouteBadge (provider/model + source label + rationale via title tooltip), PermissionPrompt (role=dialog modal over the FIRST pending permission; Allow/Deny + a 'remember' checkbox call store.resolvePermission(requestId,{allow,remember}); renders null when queue empty), Composer (textarea + Send + Stop; hosts PerMessageOverrideControl; Send calls store.sendMessage which consumes-and-clears the shared override; Stop calls store.stopGeneration). Barrel exports added to features/chat/index.ts.

MODEL SELECTOR (src/features/model-selector/): ProviderModelPicker (REUSABLE presentational component — takes models/value/onChange + optional isLocal predicate; groups Local vs Cloud, defaulting locality to the zero-price heuristic since AvailableModel carries no kind/baseUrl per the feature's 'else group by a provided flag' allowance; shows capability labels from Capabilities and a price hint from TokenPrice / 'free' for zero-rate; exported from model-selector/index.ts so FEAT-003's DefaultRoutePicker can import it), RoutingModeToggle (Auto vs Manual radiogroup driven by the active conversation's conversationPref; Auto clears the pin via setConversationRoute(id,null); Manual reveals the picker and pins via setConversationRoute(id,route); shows AutoRationaleTooltip while Auto), PerMessageOverrideControl (reads/writes the SINGLE shared transient override in the conversations store via setPendingOverride — owns no copy; Clear button resets it), AutoRationaleTooltip (fetches get_route_explanation for the active conversation, falls back to a provided rationale e.g. last message's RouteMetadata.rationale).

SHARED SEAM / STORE CHANGES (state/conversations.ts): added sendMessage(content) (guards on activeConversationId; consumePendingOverride() reads+clears the single transient override then calls the send_message command with overrideRoute so the override applies to exactly one message; reply arrives via streaming events), stopGeneration() (calls stop_generation for the active conversation), and extended resolvePermission to the (requestId, PermissionDecision) signature per the briefing (there is NO resolve_permission IPC command in this phase — FEAT-001 did not add one — so the store dequeues locally and references the decision; documented inline). No new IPC commands or types were needed; all wrappers (sendMessage/getMessages/setConversationRoute/getRouteExplanation/stopGeneration/listAvailableModels) already existed from FEAT-001.

TESTS: features/chat/chat.test.tsx (MessageBubble renders every content variant + RouteBadge; MessageList loads get_messages, streams via applyCoreEvent messageDelta then finalizes on messageComplete toggling the StreamingIndicator, surfaces messageError; Composer Send carries the current override then the store clears it, Stop calls stop_generation; PermissionPrompt renders on permissionRequested and Allow calls resolvePermission dequeuing it) and features/model-selector/model-selector.test.tsx (ProviderModelPicker groups Local vs Cloud with capability/price hints and fires onChange; RoutingModeToggle Auto clears the pin (set_conversation_route null) and Manual pins the chosen model; PerMessageOverrideControl writes the shared store override and a subsequent send carries it; providersChanged refreshes the model list). Updated conversations.test.ts: resolvePermission now takes a decision arg, plus new sendMessage-override-clear and stopGeneration cases. Both suites follow the FEAT-001 pattern: vi.mock('@tauri-apps/api/core') for invoke and vi.mock('@tauri-apps/api/event') for listen.

VERIFICATION: `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend PASSES ('All matched files use Prettier code style!'). eslint/tsc/vitest are DEFERRED to CI (no node_modules; npm registry 403 offline). Self-audited: no explicit any; no unused imports/locals; unused-but-contractual resolvePermission decision arg is referenced (void) with an explaining comment to satisfy noUnusedParameters + @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars; useEffect deps are exhaustive ([conversationId] in AutoRationaleTooltip, [activeConversationId, openConversation] in MessageList — store actions are stable refs); switch statements over closed unions (MessageContent, RouteSource) return in every arm (no fallthrough); all lines <=100 cols and TS unions single-line where they fit. Rust untouched (FEAT-001 added the commands).
